a.text: Approving a technical institution takes many hands, many documents, and many deadlines.

d.text: This prototype keeps every one of them visible, from the first form to the final decision.

chapters.title: The public portal
chapters.purpose: Schedules and rule changes, open to everyone

a.text: Before anyone signs in, the public portal shows this cycle's schedule, and every rule change.

d.text: Accessibility is not an extra screen. It is built into every page.

events.text: Text can be made larger.
The whole site switches to Hindi.
And a high-contrast mode helps anyone with low vision.

chapters.title: A college files
chapters.purpose: Catch mistakes while the form is being filled

a.text: Applications are long, and a mistake found months later can cost a college the whole cycle.

d.text: Problems are caught at the desk, not months later.

events.text: ABC Engineering College starts a new application. The header shows the cycle, and the exact rules version it is filing under.
Here, the built-up area is entered as larger than the land itself.
Check my entries flags it straight away, as advice, not a block. The college corrects the figure.

events.label: Programme
events.text: B.Tech Computer Science
But a missing critical document does block submission, and the message names it: the land lease.
With the lease attached, the application goes in.
Submitted, with its own application number.

chapters.title: Assigned, with reasons
chapters.purpose: Who handles a case, and why

a.text: In most offices, who handles a case, and why, is invisible.

events.text: The new case is already in Priya's Action Center.
And it says why: she is the portfolio officer for this college, with her workload and the rules version that applies.

chapters.title: Return and reply
chapters.purpose: A clock that is fair to both sides

a.text: Delays are often blamed on the wrong side.

d.text: The clock is fair to both sides.

events.text: Priya finds the lease covers only two years. She returns the application, naming the document and the reason.

events.label: Reason
events.text: Lease covers 2 years, 3 required
The case turns amber. The clock is paused, because the next move is the college's.
The college replies with a three-year lease.

events.label: Reply note
events.text: Attached the renewed lease valid for 3 years.
And the case goes straight back to Priya, with the days that were left, not a fresh deadline.

a.text: Overdue work tends to be forgotten, quietly.

events.text: For the demo, the administrator moves the simulated date forward by twenty days.
The deadline engine has escalated the unscheduled visit to the manager, Kumar. Exactly once. And his dashboard shows why.

a.text: When an officer is away, their queue usually just stops.

events.text: Kumar records a week of medical leave for Arjun. His open tasks are released, and reassigned, each with a reason.

events.label: Reason
events.text: Medical leave

events.label: Tasks reassigned, each with a reason

events.text: Kumar can also move work by hand. The system recommends who has capacity, and his choice is recorded.

events.label: Reason
events.text: Spreading work in the team

a.text: Approval is not the end. The conditions attached to it have to be met.

d.text: From application to closure, one traceable thread.

events.text: Ravi schedules the expert visit, with a committee proposed by the system.
The committee files its report.

events.label: Land and buildings match the application
Land and buildings match the application
Laboratories and equipment are in place
Laboratories and equipment are in place
Faculty are in position as stated
Faculty are in position as stated
Library and learning resources are adequate
Library and learning resources are adequate
Report
events.text: Facilities match; fire NOC pending.
And the competent authority approves, with a condition: a fire no-objection certificate within ninety days.

events.label: Condition
events.text: Submit fire NOC

events.label: Reason
events.text: Meets the norms subject to the fire NOC.
Eighty-five days later, after reminders at thirty, fifteen and seven days, the college uploads the certificate. Priya verifies it.
And the case closes, on its own.

chapters.title: Rules change every year
chapters.purpose: Change that is previewed, approved and announced

a.text: Rules change every year. Sudden changes surprise colleges, and break systems.

d.text: Every change is previewed, approved by two people, and announced.

events.text: A rules editor drafts an amendment: a new required document, and a longer application window.

events.label: Reference
events.text: PROTOTYPE/CORR/2027-28/1

events.label: Title
events.text: Corrigendum (prototype)

events.label: Kind
events.text: FIRE_SAFETY_AUDIT

events.label: Label
events.text: Fire safety audit report
Applying the new document to cases already filed is refused. A tighter rule can only apply to new applications.
Before anything is published, the impact preview shows exactly who would be affected.
Then a different person, the rules approver, reviews it and publishes it. Nobody can approve their own change.
And the college sees the change the next time it signs in.

chapters.title: Trust
chapters.purpose: A record that cannot be quietly changed

a.text: An audit log that can be edited proves nothing.

d.text: Tamper-evident, and scoped to every role.

events.text: Every action is chained by hash. Verify integrity, and every row checks out.
Now, with a demo tool, one row is changed directly in the database.

events.output: [demo:tamper] changed the reason on audit row 995 (chain c216d6e1-55bc-4dc8-8822-0432c1af2249, action RELEASE).

events.text: Verification points to the exact broken row.
And when an officer opens a case outside their region, access is refused, and logged.
